Package com.github.workerframework.caf

Class AbstractWorkerFactory<C,T>

java.lang.Object
com.github.workerframework.caf.AbstractWorkerFactory<C,T>
Type Parameters:
C - the Worker Configuration type parameter
T - the Worker Task type parameter
All Implemented Interfaces:
HealthReporter, WorkerFactory
public abstract class AbstractWorkerFactory<C,T> extends Object implements WorkerFactory
A WorkerFactory that uses a pre-defined configuration and Worker task class. This is the recommended abstract base to create a WorkerFactory from.

    • verifyWorkerTaskAndSetResponse

      protected final T verifyWorkerTaskAndSetResponse(WorkerTask workerTask)
      Verify that the specified worker task has the right type and is a version that can be handled.

      Note that whereas verifyWorkerTask() will throw an exception when there is an issue, this method will instead use the setResponse() method on the WorkerTask and then return null.
